s.H6214: from 6213 and 410; God has made; Asahel, the name of four Israelites KJV: Asahel.

s.H6216: from 6231; oppressive (as noun, a tyrant) KJV: oppressor.
s.H6217: or עָשֻׁק; passive participle of 6231; used in plural masculine as abstractly, tyranny KJV: oppressed(-ion). [Doubtful.]
s.H6218: or עָשֹׂר; from 6235; ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord KJV: (instrument of) ten (strings, -th).
s.H6219: from 6245; shining, i.e. polished KJV: bright.
s.H6220: for 6219; bright; Ashvath, an Israelite KJV: Ashvath.
s.H6221: from 6213 and 410; made of God; Asiel, an Israelite KJV: Asiel.
s.H6222: from 6213 and 3050; Jah has made; Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites KJV: Asaiah.
s.H6223: from 6238; rich, whether literal or figurative (noble) KJV: rich (man).
s.H6224: from 6235; tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part KJV: tenth (part).
s.H6225: a primitive root; to smoke, whether literal or figurative KJV: be angry (be on a) smoke.
s.H6227: from 6225; smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger) KJV: smoke(-ing).
s.H6228: the same as 6227; Ashan, a place in Palestine KJV: Ashan.
s.H6229: a primitive root (identical with 6231); to press upon, i.e. quarrel KJV: strive with.
s.H6231: a primitive root (compare 6229); to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow KJV: get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress(-ion), -or), do violence (wrong).
s.H6232: from 6231; oppression; Eshek, an Israelite KJV: Eshek.
s.H6233: from 6231; injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain KJV: cruelly, extortion, oppression, thing (deceitfully gotten).
s.H6235: masculine of term עֲשָׂרָה; from 6237; ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits) KJV: ten, (fif-, seven-) teen.
s.H6236: (Aramaic) masculine עֲשְׂרָה (Aramaic); corresponding to 6235; ten KJV: ten, twelve.
s.H6237: a primitive root (identical with 6238); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from 6235; to tithe, i.e. to take or give a tenth KJV: × surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), × truly.
s.H6238: a primitive root; properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich KJV: be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See 6240.
s.H6240: for 6235; ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen; also (ordinal) -teenth KJV: (eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-) teen(-th), + eleven(-th), + sixscore thousand, + twelve(-th).
s.H6241: or עִשָּׂרֹן; from 6235; (fractional) a tenth part KJV: tenth deal.
s.H6242: from 6235; twenty; also (ordinal) twentieth KJV: (six-) score, twenty(-ieth).
s.H6244: a primitive root; probably to shrink, i.e. fail KJV: be consumed.
s.H6245: a primitive root; probably to be sleek, i.e. glossy; hence (through the idea of polishing) to excogitate (as if forming in the mind) KJV: shine, think.
s.H6246: (Aramaic) corresponding to 6245; to purpose KJV: think.
s.H6249: apparently masculine plural construction of 6247 in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with 6240 in lieu of 259) eleven or (ordinal) eleventh KJV: eleven(-th).
